items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: The first record I produced was “Digital Duke” which won a Grammy for Mercer

ctx.x: Oh man that’s very interesting stuff. And you worked with Dave Grusin?

Yeah well through Allegro and GRP. Which was fine. I mean that was a lot of good stuff. I mean it was a period I was coming out of a certain kind of a dead spot for years. And the first record I produced, I didn’t do a lot of writing for the label, I did more producing than writing. The first record I produced was “Digital Duke” which won a Grammy for Mercer, which was fun because it had all those Ellington things and it was a lot of the guys — Louie Bellson and Norris Turney and Clark. So that was fun. And we…
